question_en: Before using a measuring instrument for a critical electrical test, what should the electrician verify?
options: That it has been calibrated according to manufacturer specifications and facility policy.
That its case colour matches the panel.
That it was purchased within the last year.
That it is set to its highest range regardless of the task.
explanation_en: A-2.01 requires measuring equipment to be calibrated according to manufacturer specifications and facility policy.
explanation_es: A-2.01 exige que los instrumentos de medición estén calibrados según el fabricante y la política de la instalación.

question_en: An electrician is locating equipment from a scaled drawing. What is the correct approach?
options: Use the drawing scale and measurements, then cross-reference the applicable plans and specifications.
Estimate the location from memory.
Use only the equipment nameplate.
Ignore revisions if the drawing is legible.
explanation_en: A-3.01 requires using drawing scale/measurements and cross-referencing plans, drawings and specifications.
explanation_es: A-3.01 exige usar la escala/mediciones del plano y cruzar la información con planos y especificaciones.

question_en: The field installation does not match the drawing set in the work package. What should be established before work proceeds?
options: Whether the plans, drawings, schematics and specifications are current for the existing installation.
Which drawing has the newest-looking paper.
Whether the equipment can be moved to match the old drawing.
Only the original construction date.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires verification that plans, drawings, schematics and specifications are current for the existing installation.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige verificar que planos, diagramas y especificaciones estén vigentes para la instalación existente.

question_en: When installing brackets, hangers and fasteners for electrical equipment, what should guide their selection and installation?
options: Specifications, intended purpose, site obstructions and required secure/aligned installation.
Only the colour of the support.
Only the shortest installation time.
Any fastener that physically fits the hole.
explanation_en: A-4.02 requires supports/fasteners to be selected for specifications and intended purpose and installed while accounting for obstructions and proper alignment.
explanation_es: A-4.02 exige seleccionar soportes/fijaciones según especificaciones y propósito, considerando obstrucciones y correcta alineación.

question_en: Immediately before startup during commissioning, which check is specifically required?
options: Remove shipping material, debris and tools, secure loose hardware, and verify operational parameters from documentation/nameplates.
Increase all protection settings.
Disconnect all status and alarm circuits.
Ignore other trades until the system is energized.
explanation_en: A-5.01 requires removal of shipping material/tools/loose hardware and verification of operational parameters before startup.
explanation_es: A-5.01 exige retirar materiales de transporte/herramientas, asegurar hardware suelto y verificar parámetros antes del arranque.

question_en: A shutdown is complete and the system is being prepared for startup. Which action belongs in the RSOS startup preparation?
options: Verify field wiring against drawings, verify connections/torque, remove temporary grounds/jumpers/debris, then follow the specified startup sequence.
Energize first and check drawings afterward.
Leave temporary protective grounds installed during normal operation.
Skip personnel notification if the equipment is remote.
explanation_en: A-5.02 requires verification of drawings/connections, removal of temporary items, personnel notification and the specified startup sequence.
explanation_es: A-5.02 exige verificar planos/conexiones, retirar elementos temporales, notificar al personal y seguir la secuencia especificada de arranque.

question_en: A three-phase service has an intermittent metering problem. What should occur before a repair decision is made?
options: Obtain and document a detailed malfunction description, then determine the source using field assessment and test results.
Replace all metering equipment without testing.
Change the service voltage.
Ignore operator information.
explanation_en: B-7.04 begins maintenance by documenting the malfunction and determining its source from field assessment and diagnostic/test results.
explanation_es: B-7.04 inicia documentando la falla y determinando su fuente mediante evaluación de campo y pruebas.

question_en: Testing has identified the source of a three-phase service malfunction. What should determine the next course of action?
options: The type of malfunction and availability of replacement parts.
Only the age of the building.
Only the service conductor colour.
The lowest-cost action regardless of compatibility.
explanation_en: B-7.04 states that the course of action is determined by the identified malfunction and availability of replacement parts.
explanation_es: B-7.04 indica que el curso de acción depende del tipo de falla y la disponibilidad de repuestos.

question_en: A breaker passes an operational cycle but its contact-resistance result has worsened compared with commissioning data. What is the proper maintenance approach?
options: Evaluate the result against previous data, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation before deciding maintenance action.
Ignore the resistance because the breaker opened once.
Increase the breaker rating.
Delete the previous test records.
explanation_en: B-8.02 requires maintenance test results to be evaluated against previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_es: B-8.02 exige evaluar los resultados contra datos previos, especificaciones del fabricante y documentación de commissioning.

question_en: A scheduled overcurrent-device test produces a result outside the manufacturer specification. What is the best next step?
options: Use the test result and applicable maintenance references to determine required maintenance rather than returning the device to service without evaluation.
Change the panel label only.
Discard the test result and repeat next year.
Raise the trip setting until it passes.
explanation_en: The RSOS links scheduled testing, documented results, evaluation and maintenance requirements for protection devices.
explanation_es: El RSOS vincula pruebas programadas, resultados documentados, evaluación y requisitos de mantenimiento de los dispositivos de protección.

question_en: A low-voltage distribution component shows abnormal heating on a thermographic inspection. What should guide the troubleshooting decision?
options: Field assessment and diagnostic/test results, followed by a course of action based on the identified malfunction.
Replace every panel component immediately.
Ignore the finding until a breaker trips.
Use only the equipment age.
explanation_en: B-9.02 requires determining the source of malfunction from field assessments and diagnostic/test results, then selecting a course of action.
explanation_es: B-9.02 exige determinar la fuente de la falla mediante evaluaciones/pruebas y después decidir el curso de acción.

question_en: Maintenance testing on low-voltage distribution equipment differs from previous commissioning results. How should the electrician evaluate it?
options: Compare it with previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
Compare it only with another building.
Accept it if no visible smoke is present.
Change the equipment rating on the drawing.
explanation_en: B-9.02 explicitly requires comparison with previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_es: B-9.02 exige comparar con resultados previos, especificaciones del fabricante y documentación de commissioning.

question_en: After replacing a malfunctioning component in a power-conditioning system, what is required before returning the system to service?
options: Test the repaired system/components according to applicable specifications and verify operation.
Bypass the conditioning equipment permanently.
Increase capacitor size without analysis.
Erase previous maintenance data.
explanation_en: The RSOS maintenance process requires repair/replacement followed by testing and verification of operation.
explanation_es: El proceso de mantenimiento del RSOS exige reparación/reemplazo seguido de pruebas y verificación de operación.

question_en: A facility reports poor power factor and harmonic problems. Which approach best matches the equipment categories identified by the RSOS?
options: Evaluate power-factor-correction equipment and harmonic-reduction equipment as distinct parts of power conditioning.
Increase motor overload settings.
Replace all branch-circuit receptacles.
Treat the problem only as a lighting fault.
explanation_en: The RSOS includes power-factor-correction equipment and harmonic-reduction equipment within power-conditioning systems.
explanation_es: El RSOS incluye equipos de corrección de factor de potencia y reducción de armónicos dentro del acondicionamiento de energía.

question_en: When setting parameters on ground-fault protection or detection equipment, what should the settings be based on?
options: System requirements, manufacturer information, coordination requirements and applicable code requirements.
Only the highest available setting.
Only conductor colour.
Only the previous electrician preference.
explanation_en: The RSOS identifies system/manufacturer/coordination/code requirements as the basis for ground-fault protection/detection parameters.
explanation_es: El RSOS establece requisitos del sistema, fabricante, coordinación y código como base de los parámetros de protección/detección de falla a tierra.
